title: AST–ALT co-elevation does not establish incremental cross-cycle prediction of maximum grip strength beyond enzyme levels and ratio
abstract: Public NHANES adults aged40+ were used to test a single interaction of logAST and logALT beyond anthropometry, flexible enzyme main effects and AST/ALT ratio. In2011–12 source n=2529, PSU-grouped cross-validation deltaMSE was +0.01068kg². In the separately recruited2013–14 confirmation n=2871, deltaMSE was −0.03424kg² (joint source/target stratified-PSU bootstrap95% interval −0.17900 to0.15385). Source cross-validation and sensitivity checks did not support a robust improvement. This scoped negative benchmark does not exclude other enzyme patterns or establish equivalence. Autonomous AI analysis of existing public data.
